# GTS profile

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:gtsProfile`](gmeow-gtsProfile.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/gtsProfile>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

The declared profile of a segment (spec §13) — a value vocabulary individual naming the segment's purpose and requirement set. Functional per segment; a multi-segment DOCUMENT's effective requirement set is the union of its segments' profiles (spec §3.1) and is derived, never asserted.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) -> [`gmeow:GTSProfile`](../classes/gmeow-GTSProfile.md); functional
